c74object.name: jit.pdfmatrix
c74object.digest: Renders a page of a PDF file into a Jitter matrix
c74object.description: Loads a PDF file and outputs its pages as Jitter matrices. Part of the SyncSuite package.

inlet.digest: Messages controlling the loaded PDF and current page
inlet.description: Accepts the "read", "load", "page" and "dump" messages described below, as well as a bare int (treated the same as "page"). There is no matrix inlet — jit.pdfmatrix does not accept or process incoming matrices.

outlet.description: Outputs a Jitter matrix each time "read"/"load", "page", a bare int, or "dump" renders a page.

outlet.digest: Page count, then page number and dimensions
outlet.description: Outputs "count <numpages>" once, right after a successful "read"/"load". Then, right before each page's matrix goes out the left outlet, outputs a plain 3-int list "<page> <width> <height>" for that page.

objarg.name: filename
objarg.digest: PDF file to load at creation time
objarg.description: If given, jit.pdfmatrix loads this file at creation, equivalent to sending it a "read" message with the same argument. Optional; if omitted, no file is loaded until a "read"/"load" message is sent.

method.name: read
method.description: Opens "filename" (a POSIX path; "~" is expanded) and loads it as the current document, replacing any previously loaded PDF. On success, reports "count <numpages>" out the right outlet, then renders page 1 out the left outlet (preceded by its "1 <width> <height>" report out the right outlet). If the file cannot be opened or is not a valid PDF, posts "jit.pdfmatrix: could not read "<filename>" as a PDF" to the Max window and leaves any previously loaded document untouched.

method.name: load
method.description: Identical to "read": loads "filename" as the current document. See "read" above.

method.name: page
method.digest: Renders a page of the loaded PDF
method.description: Rasterizes page "page-number" (1-based, clamped to the document's page range) of the currently loaded PDF. Reports "<page-number> <width> <height>" out the right outlet, then outputs the matrix out the left outlet. A bare int sent to the inlet does the same thing. If no PDF has been loaded yet, posts "jit.pdfmatrix: no PDF loaded, use the "read" message first" to the Max window.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Renders every page of the loaded PDF, in order
method.description: Rasterizes and outputs every page of the currently loaded PDF, from page 1 to the last page: for each page, its "<page> <width> <height>" report goes out the right outlet immediately before that page's matrix goes out the left outlet. Useful for filling a jit.matrixset — wire the right outlet into its control message inlet and the left outlet into its matrix inlet. If no PDF has been loaded yet, posts "jit.pdfmatrix: no PDF loaded, use the "read" message first" to the Max window.

attribute.name: file
attribute.description: Reports the path of the PDF file currently loaded via "read"/"load" or the object's argument, or an empty symbol if none is loaded. Setting it (e.g. with "@file <path>") loads that file, exactly like sending it a "read" message.
